condition_name: Steep Required Run Rate in Chase
cricket_rationale: In the back 10 overs of a chase, scoring at >10.5 RPO requires aggressive boundary hitting with minimal dot balls.
Early top-order collapse puts incoming batters under intense pressure to rebuild while maintaining target pace.
Final 4 overs where chase is actively contested and comfortable walkovers (RRR < 7.5 with 5+ wickets in hand) are rigorously excluded.
Severe wicket losses early in the 1st innings threaten a sub-par total or all-out dismissal.

condition_name: First Innings Death Overs Wicket Scarcity
cricket_rationale: Batters must launch death over acceleration while protecting remaining tailend wickets.
Bowler defends a tight target where execution directly decides match outcome; cruising chases with low RRR are strictly excluded.
Defending sub-145 scores where the match is actively contested; comfortable batting strolls are strictly excluded.
Bowling against destructive set finishers in the death overs when batting side has heavy resources in hand.
Opponent is flying at >9.5 RPO in powerplay/early overs; bowler brought on under pressure to halt momentum. Explicitly verified pre-delivery score.
